hook: Imagine money arriving every month from things you own, not from your job. In this video I walk through 15 assets that can pay you monthly, from three angles: the numbers (savings, money market funds, T-bills, CDs, bond funds), the psychology of higher-yield traps (dividends, REITs, rentals, covered calls, annuities), and a playbook to build your own monthly income machine in layers.
shorts: How much money do you need to earn a thousand dollars a month without working?
The U.S. government will pay you interest. Here's how to get it every month
That fund paying ten percent a year has a hidden cost most people miss
The most underrated monthly income asset might be the roof over your head
Two investors wanted monthly income. One chased yield. One built a system
